Determines the style

Space between items

Custom CSS class for additional styling
Global attributes can define defaults which are merged with attributes provided by the caller

examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" class="max-w-2xl"> Every page you publish is compiled once and cached, so a request never waits on the <.component component_name="chelekom-popover" site="Global" id="glossary-runtime-popover" inline rounded="medium" padding="small" width="large" position="top"> <:trigger class="font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"> runtime compiler <:content> The step that turns a stored template into a real Phoenix module. It runs when you publish, not when a visitor arrives. again. Editing a page puts it back in the queue, and the old version keeps serving until the new one is ready.

examples:
Ninety days in

<.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3 tracking-tight"> 4,200 operations teams plan their week in Northwind <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"> We asked customers what actually changed after they switched. These three answers came back the most.
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-grid" cols="one" gap="extra_large" class="mt-14 items-start md:grid-cols-3"> <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-onboarding" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Customer onboarding took eleven days and four handoffs. We rebuilt the whole flow in a single sprint and it now finishes the same afternoon. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-onboarding-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Nadia Kessler VP Customer Success, Loop Freight <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-forecast" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> The forecast used to live in one spreadsheet that one person understood. Now every regional lead owns their own numbers and the roll-up is correct before I get in. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-forecast-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Marta Oyelaran Director of Revenue Operations, Vantage Cold Chain <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-support" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Support and product finally read the same board. Escalations that used to sit for a week get picked up the same day, and nobody chases anybody in chat any more. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-support-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Ingrid Sollberger Head of Support, Marrow Bank

Halden Instruments — 240 field engineers

<.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="halden-featured-quote" size="extra_large" border="large" padding="extra_large" rounded="large" space="medium" class="mt-4" blockquote_class="p-0! text-xl leading-9 sm:text-2xl"> We retired four internal tools and put everything in one workspace. The part I did not expect was the quiet — no more Friday scramble to work out what actually shipped. <:caption> Reuben Adeyemi Chief Operating Officer
<.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="halden-stat-hours" size="large" title="Hours returned each week" value="1,180" description="Measured across every field team" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="halden-stat-tools" size="large" title="Tools retired" value="4" description="Consolidated in one quarter" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="halden-stat-cycle" size="large" title="Release cycle" value="9 days" description="Down from six weeks" />

Case study — Ferrous Rail

<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3 tracking-tight"> Rebuilding a booking flow that forty thousand people use before breakfast <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-6 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> Ferrous Rail came to us with a checkout that worked and nobody liked. Seven screens, two of them asking for the same date, and a payment step that timed out on the platform Wi-Fi at exactly the moment people needed it most. <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> We spent the first three weeks not designing anything. We rode the 07:14 out of Leeds with a stopwatch and watched two hundred people try to buy a ticket standing up, one-handed, with a coffee. <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="ferrous-pull-quote" variant="outline" color="primary" border="large" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="none" space="medium" class="my-10" blockquote_class="p-0! text-xl leading-9 sm:text-2xl"> They came back with a stopwatch and a commute, not a mood board. Three screens went in the bin and our completion rate moved nineteen points in a fortnight. <:caption position="left"> Priya Raghunathan Head of Digital, Ferrous Rail <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> The rebuilt flow is three screens and holds its state offline, so a dropped signal in a tunnel no longer costs a sale. It shipped in eleven weeks and has not been touched since, which is the outcome we are proudest of.

<.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="tracking-tight"> Tidemark 3.0 shipped last week <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"> A full rewrite of the sync engine, a new offline mode, and a settings screen that finally fits on one page. Here is what the reviewers made of it.
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-grid" cols="one" gap="extra_large" class="mt-12 items-start md:grid-cols-2"> <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-fieldnotes" variant="bordered" color="silver" full_border={true} border="small" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> The rare rewrite that makes an app smaller and faster at the same time. Sync finished before we could put the phone down, and the offline mode is the first one we have tested that does not lose an edit. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-fieldnotes-badge" variant="default" color="dark" size="small" rounded="full"> Field Notes Weekly <:caption> Camille Duarte Senior Editor <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-signalcast" variant="bordered" color="silver" full_border={true} border="small" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Version two asked you to learn it. Version three just gets out of the way. We handed it to four people who had never seen the app and none of them opened the help page. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-signalcast-badge" variant="default" color="dark" size="small" rounded="full"> Signalcast Review <:caption> Tobias Lindqvist Mobile Correspondent

examples.label: SaaS social-proof band with three rated customer quotes
examples.source:
Ninety days in

<.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3 tracking-tight"> 4,200 operations teams plan their week in Northwind <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"> We asked customers what actually changed after they switched. These three answers came back the most.
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-grid" cols="one" gap="extra_large" class="mt-14 items-start md:grid-cols-3"> <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-onboarding" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Customer onboarding took eleven days and four handoffs. We rebuilt the whole flow in a single sprint and it now finishes the same afternoon. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-onboarding-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Nadia Kessler VP Customer Success, Loop Freight <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-forecast" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> The forecast used to live in one spreadsheet that one person understood. Now every regional lead owns their own numbers and the roll-up is correct before I get in. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-forecast-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Marta Oyelaran Director of Revenue Operations, Vantage Cold Chain <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-support" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Support and product finally read the same board. Escalations that used to sit for a week get picked up the same day, and nobody chases anybody in chat any more. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-support-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Ingrid Sollberger Head of Support, Marrow Bank

examples.label: Enterprise case-study quote beside its outcome metrics
examples.source:
Halden Instruments — 240 field engineers

<.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="halden-featured-quote" size="extra_large" border="large" padding="extra_large" rounded="large" space="medium" class="mt-4" blockquote_class="p-0! text-xl leading-9 sm:text-2xl"> We retired four internal tools and put everything in one workspace. The part I did not expect was the quiet — no more Friday scramble to work out what actually shipped. <:caption> Reuben Adeyemi Chief Operating Officer
<.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="halden-stat-hours" size="large" title="Hours returned each week" value="1,180" description="Measured across every field team" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="halden-stat-tools" size="large" title="Tools retired" value="4" description="Consolidated in one quarter" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-stat" site="Global" id="halden-stat-cycle" size="large" title="Release cycle" value="9 days" description="Down from six weeks" />

examples.label: Agency case-study pull quote breaking a column of body copy
examples.source:
Case study — Ferrous Rail

<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3 tracking-tight"> Rebuilding a booking flow that forty thousand people use before breakfast <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-6 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> Ferrous Rail came to us with a checkout that worked and nobody liked. Seven screens, two of them asking for the same date, and a payment step that timed out on the platform Wi-Fi at exactly the moment people needed it most. <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> We spent the first three weeks not designing anything. We rode the 07:14 out of Leeds with a stopwatch and watched two hundred people try to buy a ticket standing up, one-handed, with a coffee. <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="ferrous-pull-quote" variant="outline" color="primary" border="large" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="none" space="medium" class="my-10" blockquote_class="p-0! text-xl leading-9 sm:text-2xl"> They came back with a stopwatch and a commute, not a mood board. Three screens went in the bin and our completion rate moved nineteen points in a fortnight. <:caption position="left"> Priya Raghunathan Head of Digital, Ferrous Rail <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> The rebuilt flow is three screens and holds its state offline, so a dropped signal in a tunnel no longer costs a sale. It shipped in eleven weeks and has not been touched since, which is the outcome we are proudest of.

examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="tracking-tight"> Tidemark 3.0 shipped last week <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"> A full rewrite of the sync engine, a new offline mode, and a settings screen that finally fits on one page. Here is what the reviewers made of it.
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-grid" cols="one" gap="extra_large" class="mt-12 items-start md:grid-cols-2"> <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-fieldnotes" variant="bordered" color="silver" full_border={true} border="small" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> The rare rewrite that makes an app smaller and faster at the same time. Sync finished before we could put the phone down, and the offline mode is the first one we have tested that does not lose an edit. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-fieldnotes-badge" variant="default" color="dark" size="small" rounded="full"> Field Notes Weekly <:caption> Camille Duarte Senior Editor <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-signalcast" variant="bordered" color="silver" full_border={true} border="small" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Version two asked you to learn it. Version three just gets out of the way. We handed it to four people who had never seen the app and none of them opened the help page. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-signalcast-badge" variant="default" color="dark" size="small" rounded="full"> Signalcast Review <:caption> Tobias Lindqvist Mobile Correspondent

The Meridian desk shelf is cut from a single walnut board, so the grain runs unbroken from one leg to the other. It lifts a 27-inch monitor to a comfortable eye line and leaves room underneath for a full-size keyboard.

Every shelf is finished by hand with a plant-based hardwax oil that can be refreshed at home rather than sent back to us.

<:panel>
Dimensions
600 x 220 x 120 mm
Material
Solid European walnut
Load rating
25 kg
Weight
3.4 kg
<:panel>
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-star" class="size-4 text-amber-500" /> 4.8 out of 5 from 214 verified buyers
Solid, heavy and completely flat. The oil finish is warmer than the photos suggest.

helpers.code:
js
|> JS.add_class("active-tab", to: "##{id}-tab-header-#{count}")
|> JS.add_class("active-tab-panel", to: "##{id}-tab-panel-#{count}")
|> JS.set_attribute({"aria-selected", "true"}, to: "##{id}-tab-header-#{count}")
|> JS.set_attribute({"tabindex", "0"}, to: "##{id}-tab-header-#{count}")
helpers.name: show_tab

helpers.code:
Enum.reduce(1..count, js, fn item, acc ->
  acc
  |> JS.remove_class("active-tab", to: "##{id}-tab-header-#{item}")
  |> JS.remove_class("active-tab-panel", to: "##{id}-tab-panel-#{item}")
  |> JS.set_attribute({"aria-selected", "false"}, to: "##{id}-tab-header-#{item}")
  |> JS.set_attribute({"tabindex", "-1"}, to: "##{id}-tab-header-#{item}")
end)

opts.doc: Inner block that renders HEEx label

components.template:
<.component component_name="chelekom-progress-section" site={assigns[:site]} :if={@value} {assigns} />
{msg}

opts.doc: HTML ID for the container
Progress value (0 to 100)
Diameter of the circle in px
Stroke width
'up' or 'down'
Direction of fill
Transition duration in ms
Custom CSS class for additional styling
add radius to progress
Determines color theme
Optional label
Global attributes can define defaults which are merged with attributes provided by the caller

components.body:
coordinate = assigns.size / 2
radius = (assigns.size - 2 * assigns.thickness) / 2
circumference = :math.pi() * radius
progress = clamp(assigns.value, 0, 100) * (circumference / 100)

assigns =
  assigns
  |> assign(:coordinate, coordinate)
  |> assign(:radius, radius)
  |> assign(:circumference, circumference)
  |> assign(:progress, progress)

components.name: chelekom-semi-circle-progress
components.template: {@label || "#{@value}%"}

opts.doc: A unique identifier used to manage state and interaction.
Determines color theme
The current value representing the progress completion (e.g., between 0 and max).
The maximum value the progress can reach. Default is 100.
The overall size of the progress element, typically in pixels. Default is 120.
The thickness of the progress stroke in pixels. Default is 10.
Optional label to be displayed along with the progress element.
Custom CSS class for additional styling.
Controls the shape of the stroke ends. Use 'round' for rounded corners.
Global attributes can define defaults which are merged with attributes provided by the caller

components.body:
radius = (assigns.size - assigns.thickness) / 2
circumference = 2 * :math.pi() * radius
progress_fraction = (assigns.max > 0 && assigns.value / assigns.max) || 0
dash_offset = circumference * (1 - progress_fraction)

assigns =

The error message to display after a failed copy operation.
Label for the button used to trigger the copy operation.
Optional description text for screen readers, providing more context about the clipboard functionality.

If true, displays the visual clipboard status text (e.g., 'Copied!'). Default: true.

components.body:
assigns =
  assigns
  |> assign_new(:id, fn -> "clipboard-#{random_id()}" end)
  |> assign_new(:copy_success_text, fn -> gettext("Copied!") end)
  |> assign_new(:copy_error_text, fn -> gettext("Copy failed") end)
  |> assign_new(:copy_button_label, fn -> gettext("Copy to clipboard") end)
  |> then(fn new_assigns ->
    new_assigns
    |> assign(:status_id, "#{new_assigns.id}-status")
    |> assign(:content_id, "#{new_assigns.id}-content")
  end)

helpers.code:
all_rest =
  (["pinging"] ++ @indicator_positions)
  |> Enum.map(
    &if is_binary(&1) do
      String.to_atom(&1)
    else
      &1
    end
  )

Map.drop(rest, all_rest)
helpers.name: drop_rest

components.name: chelekom-indicator
components.template:
<span
  id={@id}
  class={[
    indicator_size(@size),
    color_class(@color),
    "indicator block rounded-full absolute -translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 right-auto top-0 left-0 indicator-top-left",
    !is_nil(@rest[:pinging]) && "animate-ping",
    @class
  ]}
  {drop_rest(@rest)}
/>

item_button

helpers.code:
total_pages = max(total, 0)
total_page_numbers = siblings * 2 + 3 + boundaries * 2

pagination_range =
  if total_page_numbers >= total_pages do
    range(1, total_pages)
  else
    left_sibling_index = max(current_page - siblings, boundaries + 1)
    right_sibling_index = min(current_page + siblings, total_pages - boundaries)
    should_show_left_dots = left_sibling_index > boundaries + 2
    should_show_right_dots = right_sibling_index < total_pages - boundaries - 1
    dots = :dots

    cond do
      !should_show_left_dots and should_show_right_dots ->
        left_item_count = siblings * 2 + boundaries + 2
        range(1, left_item_count) ++ [dots] ++ range(total_pages - boundaries + 1, total_pages)

      should_show_left_dots and not should_show_right_dots ->
        right_item_count = boundaries + 1 + 2 * siblings
        range(1, boundaries) ++ [dots] ++ range(total_pages - right_item_count + 1, total_pages)

      true ->
        range(1, boundaries) ++
          [dots] ++
          range(left_sibling_index, right_sibling_index) ++
          [dots] ++ range(total_pages - boundaries + 1, total_pages)
    end
  end

%{range: pagination_range(current_page, pagination_range), active: current_page}

if active != 1 and (active - 1) not in range do
  index = Enum.find_index(range, &(&1 == active))
  List.insert_at(range, index, active - 1)
else
  range
end

<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shield-exclamation" class="size-5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />

Cookies on this site

Essential cookies keep your cart and your sign-in working. Analytics cookies tell us which guides people actually finish, so we can write more of them. Nothing is ever sold to advertisers.

components.name: chelekom-keyboard

opts.doc: Inner block that renders HEEx content

components.template:
<kbd
  id={@id}
  class={[
    "px-2 py-1.5",
    color_variant(@variant, @color),
    size_class(@size),
    border_class(@border, @variant),
    rounded_size(@rounded),
    @font_weight,
    @class
  ]}
  {@rest}
>
  {render_slot(@inner_block)}
</kbd>

Specifies the title of the element

Determines the style

Determines the overall size of the elements, including padding, font size, and other items
Determines border style
Determines the element position
Custom CSS class for additional styling to drawer wrapper
Custom CSS class for additional styling to close button
Custom CSS class for additional styling to content

Custom CSS class for additional styling to overlay
Custom JS module for on_hide action
Custom JS module for on_show action

examples: <.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" size="double_large" font_weight="font-semibold">Why we rewrote the editor <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global">The old editor asked you to hold two things in your head at once: the page you were writing and the markup it would become. Every change meant a save, a reload, and a guess about what had moved. <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global">The new one renders the real components on a real canvas. What you drag is what ships, and the only thing left to guess about is the copy.

<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Drafts stay private <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">A draft is only ever reachable through the preview link you generate, and that link expires the moment you publish.
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Every change is reversible <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">Each publish keeps the version before it, so rolling back a bad afternoon takes one click and no database work.

assigns.page_title: Checkbox card - Chelekom Phoenix & LiveView component

demo_examples.raw_source:
<.form_wrapper
              for={@form}
              id="user-form"
              phx-change="validate"
              phx-submit="save"
              space="medium"
            >
              <.h5>Full Name</.h5>
              <.text_field size="medium" field={@form[:fullname]} />

              <.h5>Select your area of expertise</.h5>

              <.radio_card field={@form[:job]} cols="three" size="extra_small" class="text-center">
                <:radio
                  :for={item <- Ecto.Enum.values(User, :job)}
                  value={"#{item}"}
                  checked={radio_check(:list, {:job, "#{item}"}, @form)}
                  title={String.capitalize("#{item}")}
                  icon={radio_card_icons("#{item}")}
                >
                </:radio>
              </.radio_card>

              <.h5>What is your hobbies?</.h5>

              <.checkbox_card
                field={@form[:hobbies]}
                cols="three"
                size="extra_small"
                class="text-center"
                variant="bordered"
                color="natural"
              >
                <:checkbox
                  value="reading"
                  title="Reading"
                  icon="hero-book-open"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "reading"}, @form)}
                >
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="programming"
                  icon="hero-computer-desktop"
                  title="Programming"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "programming"}, @form)}
                >
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="photography"
                  icon="hero-camera"
                  title="Photography"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "photography"}, @form)}
                >
                </:checkbox>
              </.checkbox_card>
              <hr class="border-b h-[1px] border-[#E5E7EB] dark:border-gray-500" />

              <.h5>Do you accept terms and conditions?</.h5>
              <.toggle_field
                field={@form[:accepted_terms]}
                checked={toggle_check(:accepted_terms, @form)}
                color="info"
                phx-debounce="300"
              />

              <:actions>
                <.button variant="outline" color="info" size="small" phx-disable-with="Saving...">
                  Save User
                </.button>
              </:actions>
            </.form_wrapper>

<.form_wrapper
              for={@form}
              id="user-form"
              phx-change="validate"
              phx-submit="save"
              space="large"
              variant="transparent"
            >
              <.text_field size="medium" label="Full name" field={@form[:fullname]} />

              <.group_radio field={@form[:job]} space="small" variation="horizontal" color="base">
                <:radio
                  :for={item <- Ecto.Enum.values(User, :job)}
                  value={"#{item}"}
                  checked={radio_check(:list, {:job, "#{item}"}, @form)}
                >
                  {String.capitalize("#{item}")}
                </:radio>
              </.group_radio>

              <.h3>What is your hobbies?</.h3>

              <.group_checkbox variation="horizontal" field={@form[:hobbies]} color="base">
                <:checkbox
                  value="reading"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "reading"}, @form)}
                >
                  Reading
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="programming"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "programming"}, @form)}
                >
                  Programming
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="photography"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "photography"}, @form)}
                >
                  Photography
                </:checkbox>
              </.group_checkbox>

              <.file_field
                target={:avatar}
                uploads={@uploads}
                dropzone_type="image"
                color="base"
                dropzone
              />
              <hr />

              <.checkbox_field
                field={@form[:accepted_terms]}
                label="Terms"
                value="true"
                color="base"
                checked={checkbox_check(:boolean, :accepted_terms, @form)}
              />

              <:actions>
                <.button
                  variant="outline"
                  color="natural"
                  size="small"
                  phx-disable-with="Saving..."
                >
                  Save User
                </.button>

<.form_wrapper
              for={@form}
              id="user-form"
              phx-change="validate"
              phx-submit="save"
              space="medium"
            >
              <.h5>Full Name</.h5>
              <.text_field size="medium" field={@form[:fullname]} />

              <.h5>Select your area of expertise</.h5>

              <.radio_card field={@form[:job]} cols="three" size="extra_small" class="text-center">
                <:radio
                  :for={item <- Ecto.Enum.values(User, :job)}
                  value={"#{item}"}
                  checked={radio_check(:list, {:job, "#{item}"}, @form)}
                  title={String.capitalize("#{item}")}
                  icon={radio_card_icons("#{item}")}
                >
                </:radio>
              </.radio_card>

              <.h5>What is your hobbies?</.h5>

              <.group_checkbox
                variation="horizontal"
                field={@form[:hobbies]}
                color="natural"
                size="large"
              >
                <:checkbox
                  value="reading"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "reading"}, @form)}
                >
                  Reading
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="programming"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "programming"}, @form)}
                >
                  Programming
                </:checkbox>
                <:checkbox
                  value="photography"
                  checked={checkbox_check(:list, {:hobbies, "photography"}, @form)}
                >
                  Photography
                </:checkbox>
              </.group_checkbox>
              <hr class="border-b h-[1px] border-[#E5E7EB] dark:border-gray-500" />

              <.h5>Do you accept terms and conditions?</.h5>
              <.toggle_field
                field={@form[:accepted_terms]}
                checked={toggle_check(:accepted_terms, @form)}
                color="info"
                phx-debounce="300"
              />

              <:actions>
                <.button variant="outline" color="info" size="small" phx-disable-with="Saving...">
                  Save User
                </.button>
              </:actions>
            </.form_wrapper>

components.body:
assigns = assigns |> assign_new(:id, fn -> "accordion-#{random_id()}" end)

items_with_ids =
  assigns.item
  |> Enum.with_index(1)
  |> Enum.map(fn {item, index} ->
    if item[:id] do
      item
    else
      Map.put(item, :id, "#{assigns.id}-item-#{index}")
    end
  end)

assigns = assign(assigns, :item, items_with_ids)

<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-support-faq" multiple> <:item id="faq-billing-date" title="When am I billed?">

Subscriptions renew on the same day of each month. The exact date, along with every past invoice, is listed under Billing in your account.

<:item id="faq-plan-change" title="Can I change plans mid-cycle?">

Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and we charge only the prorated difference. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next cycle.

<:item id="faq-seats" title="How are extra seats charged?">

Every plan includes five seats. Additional seats are $9 each per month and can be added or removed at any time from the Team page.

<:item id="faq-refund" title="Do you offer refunds?">

Annual plans are refunded in full within thirty days of purchase, no questions asked. Monthly plans can be cancelled any time before the next renewal.

<:item id="faq-data-retention" title="What happens to my data if I cancel?">

Your workspace stays readable for sixty days so you can export everything you need. After that it is permanently removed from our systems and backups.

<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-shipping" variant="bordered" color="natural" padding="medium"> <:item id="ship-delivery" icon="hero-truck" title="Delivery" description="Free on orders over $60">

Standard delivery arrives in two to four working days. Express delivery is $9 and arrives the next working day when ordered before 2pm.

<:item id="ship-returns" icon="hero-arrow-uturn-left" title="Returns and exchanges" description="Thirty days, prepaid label">

Send anything back within thirty days for a full refund. Print the prepaid label from your order page, drop the parcel at any collection point, and we refund within five working days of it arriving.

<:item id="ship-warranty" icon="hero-shield-check" title="Two-year warranty" description="Covers manufacturing defects">

Every product is covered for two years against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not included, but we offer a discounted replacement in that case.

<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-release-notes" variant="base_separated" space="small" padding="medium"> <:item id="rel-2-4-0" title="Version 2.4.0" description="Released 12 March" open>
  • Draft previews now open in a side panel instead of a new browser tab.
  • Media library uploads resume automatically after a dropped connection.
  • Fixed a case where scheduled posts published an hour early on the daylight-saving changeover.
<:item id="rel-2-3-2" title="Version 2.3.2" description="Released 27 February">
  • Reduced first-paint time on the dashboard by deferring the activity feed.
  • Corrected the ordering of revisions when two edits share a timestamp.
<:item id="rel-2-3-0" title="Version 2.3.0" description="Released 9 February">
  • Added per-site notification preferences for editors and reviewers.
  • Introduced keyboard shortcuts for save, preview, and publish.

Sara joined in 2019 after seven years building editorial tools for newsrooms. She owns the roadmap and runs the monthly customer research sessions.

<:item id="team-omid" image="/images/avatar4.jpg" image_class="rounded-full object-cover" title="Omid Rahmani" description="Principal Engineer">

<:item id="team-lea" image="/images/avatar6.jpg" image_class="rounded-full object-cover" title="Lea Fontaine" description="Customer Success Lead">

examples.label: Billing FAQ with five questions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-support-faq" multiple> <:item id="faq-billing-date" title="When am I billed?">

Subscriptions renew on the same day of each month. The exact date, along with every past invoice, is listed under Billing in your account.

<:item id="faq-plan-change" title="Can I change plans mid-cycle?">

Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and we charge only the prorated difference. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next cycle.

<:item id="faq-seats" title="How are extra seats charged?">

Every plan includes five seats. Additional seats are $9 each per month and can be added or removed at any time from the Team page.

<:item id="faq-refund" title="Do you offer refunds?">

Annual plans are refunded in full within thirty days of purchase, no questions asked. Monthly plans can be cancelled any time before the next renewal.

<:item id="faq-data-retention" title="What happens to my data if I cancel?">

Your workspace stays readable for sixty days so you can export everything you need. After that it is permanently removed from our systems and backups.

examples.label: Shipping and returns panel on a product page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-shipping" variant="bordered" color="natural" padding="medium"> <:item id="ship-delivery" icon="hero-truck" title="Delivery" description="Free on orders over $60">

Standard delivery arrives in two to four working days. Express delivery is $9 and arrives the next working day when ordered before 2pm.

<:item id="ship-returns" icon="hero-arrow-uturn-left" title="Returns and exchanges" description="Thirty days, prepaid label">

Send anything back within thirty days for a full refund. Print the prepaid label from your order page, drop the parcel at any collection point, and we refund within five working days of it arriving.

<:item id="ship-warranty" icon="hero-shield-check" title="Two-year warranty" description="Covers manufacturing defects">

Every product is covered for two years against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not included, but we offer a discounted replacement in that case.

<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-release-notes" variant="base_separated" space="small" padding="medium"> <:item id="rel-2-4-0" title="Version 2.4.0" description="Released 12 March" open>
  • Draft previews now open in a side panel instead of a new browser tab.
  • Media library uploads resume automatically after a dropped connection.
  • Fixed a case where scheduled posts published an hour early on the daylight-saving changeover.
<:item id="rel-2-3-2" title="Version 2.3.2" description="Released 27 February">
  • Reduced first-paint time on the dashboard by deferring the activity feed.
  • Corrected the ordering of revisions when two edits share a timestamp.
<:item id="rel-2-3-0" title="Version 2.3.0" description="Released 9 February">
  • Added per-site notification preferences for editors and reviewers.
  • Introduced keyboard shortcuts for save, preview, and publish.

examples.label: Icon break between two article sections
examples.source:
We rebuilt the page editor from scratch this spring. Every block you drop on the canvas is now rendered by the server, which means the preview you are looking at is exactly the markup your visitors receive.

<.component component_name="chelekom-divider" site="Global" size="small" color="silver"> <:icon name="hero-sparkles" />

The next release moves that same pipeline behind reusable sections, so a change to a shared header rolls out to every page that uses it without a single copy and paste.

<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-ferrymark-inbox">
<.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="small" rounded="full" icon="hero-sparkles" class="mb-6"> Shared drafts landed in the January release <.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="tracking-tight sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl"> One inbox for every customer email your team owns <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl opacity-70"> Ferrymark puts support, sales and billing mail in one place, shows you who is already typing, and stops two people answering the same customer twice.
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/signup" variant="default" color="primary"> Create a workspace <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/product/tour" icon="hero-play-circle"> Watch a two minute tour
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-check-circle" class="size-4" /> Free for two seats <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-check-circle" class="size-4" /> Imports from Gmail in a minute <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-check-circle" class="size-4" /> Leave whenever you like

<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-kestrel-roastery" variant="transparent">
<.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" font_weight="font-semibold" class="uppercase tracking-[0.2em] opacity-60"> Wholesale roasting since 2009 <.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="mt-4 leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-5xl"> Coffee your café can pour the same way every morning <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-6 max-w-xl opacity-70"> Kestrel roasts to order on Tuesdays and Fridays, delivers across the county in its own van, and dials in your grinder on site before the first invoice goes out.
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/samples" variant="default" color="dark"> Request a sample box <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/contact" variant="outline" color="natural" icon="hero-arrow-up-right"> Talk to a roaster
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-calendar-days" class="size-5 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
Roasted Tuesday, with you Thursday
Nothing sits in a warehouse waiting for an order.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-truck" class="size-5 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
Free delivery over twenty kilos
Our own driver, so a late order is a phone call rather than a ticket.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-wrench-screwdriver" class="size-5 shrink-0 opacity-70" />
Grinder calibration included
We come back whenever the beans or the weather change.

<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-balance-sheet-course" variant="gradient" color="dawn" class="rounded-3xl">
<.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" size="small" rounded="full" icon="hero-academic-cap" class="mb-6"> Spring cohort opens on 3 March <.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="tracking-tight sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl"> Read a balance sheet in six Tuesday evenings <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-xl opacity-90"> A short evening course for founders, freelancers and anyone who has ever nodded along in a finance meeting. Taught live, no accounting background assumed.
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/enrol" variant="default" color="dark"> Enrol for spring <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/syllabus" variant="default" color="white"> See the six evenings
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-user-group" class="size-4" /> Twelve places per cohort, and they go quickly

<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-puffin-postgres" variant="bordered" color="primary" border_size="small">
<.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="tracking-tight sm:text-5xl"> Postgres that lives next door to your users <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl opacity-80"> Put a read replica in nine regions, keep one connection string, and watch your median query time drop to single digits.
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-command-line" class="size-4 shrink-0" /> npx puffin init
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/docs/quickstart" variant="default" color="primary"> Read the quickstart <.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" navigate="/pricing" variant="outline" color="primary"> See what it costs
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-bolt" class="size-4" /> 9 ms median reads <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shield-check" class="size-4" /> SOC 2 Type II <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-globe-alt" class="size-4" /> Nine regions, one URL

<.component component_name="chelekom-jumbotron" site="Global" id="hero-rookwood-house" variant="default" color="dark">
<.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" font_weight="font-semibold" class="uppercase tracking-[0.25em] opacity-70"> Rookwood House, Northumberland coast <.component component_name="chelekom-h1" site="Global" font_weight="font-bold" class="mt-5 tracking-tight sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl"> Eleven rooms, one long table, the sea two fields away <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl opacity-80"> A Georgian farmhouse turned small hotel. Dinner is at eight, breakfast runs until eleven, and the dogs are as welcome as you are.

<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-map-pin" class="size-4" /> Craster, Northumberland <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-home-modern" class="size-4" /> Eleven rooms, no two alike <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-clock" class="size-4" /> Dinner at eight, every night

assigns =
  assigns
  |> assign_new(:id, fn -> "combo-#{random_id()}" end)
  |> assign_new(:name, fn -> nil end)
  |> assign_new(:options, fn -> [] end)
  |> assign_new(:option, fn -> [] end)
  |> assign_new(:value, fn -> Map.get(assigns, :value, []) end)
  |> then(fn a ->
    if a.creatable do
      assign(a, :searchable, true)
    else
      a
    end
  end)

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn ->
  if assigns.multiple do
    field.name <> "[]"
  else
    field.name
  end
end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> combobox()

We are moving the database to a larger cluster. Publishing and the admin dashboard will be read-only while the work runs — your public pages stay online the entire time, and nothing needs to be done on your side.

Starts
Sat 16 May, 02:00 UTC
Expected duration
About 45 minutes
Affected
Editor and publishing

How to return an order

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-return-order" size="small"> <:item padding="extra_small">Open the order in your account and choose Start a return. <:item padding="extra_small">Print the prepaid label we email you within one business day. <:item padding="extra_small">Drop the parcel at any carrier point within 14 days. <:item padding="extra_small">We refund the original payment method once the parcel reaches our warehouse.

examples.label: Account setup steps as separated cards
examples.source:
Finish setting up your account

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-account-setup" variant="base_separated" size="small" space="extra_small" rounded="medium"> <:item padding="small">Confirm your email address from the link we just sent. <:item padding="small">Add a company name and logo so invoices look right. <:item padding="small">Invite the teammates who will publish with you. <:item padding="small">Connect a domain and publish your first page.

examples.label: How to return an order
examples.source:
How to return an order

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-return-order" size="small"> <:item padding="extra_small">Open the order in your account and choose Start a return. <:item padding="extra_small">Print the prepaid label we email you within one business day. <:item padding="extra_small">Drop the parcel at any carrier point within 14 days. <:item padding="extra_small">We refund the original payment method once the parcel reaches our warehouse.

examples.label: Numbered clauses in a terms of service section
examples.source:
Payment and renewal

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-terms-clauses" size="small"> <:item padding="extra_small">Subscriptions renew automatically on the anniversary of the purchase date. <:item padding="extra_small">We email an invoice to the billing address on file seven days before each renewal. <:item padding="extra_small">You may cancel at any time; access continues until the end of the paid period. <:item padding="extra_small">Prices announced on this page apply from the next renewal, never retroactively.

helpers.code:
errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn ->
  if assigns.rest[:multiple] do
    field.name <> "[]"
  else
    field.name
  end
end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> file_field()

examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-timeline" site="Global" id="timeline-company-milestones" color="primary" hide_last_line>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="Two people and a shared repository" time="2019" description="We started as a consultancy building Phoenix applications for other teams, and kept rewriting the same components on every project." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="The first open-source release" time="2021" description="Those components became a public kit. Within a year it was installed in production by more than four hundred teams." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="A content system around the kit" time="2023" description="Editors asked to change pages without a deploy, so we built the page builder that now sits at the centre of the product." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="Twelve people, still no sales team" time="2025" description="Everything we ship is used first by the people who build it, and that has not changed since the second commit." />
</.component>

helpers.code:
errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn ->
  if assigns.rest[:multiple] do
    field.name <> "[]"
  else
    field.name
  end
end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> native_select()

components.template:
<video
  id={@id}
  class={[
    width_class(@width),
    height_class(@height),
    rounded_size(@rounded),
    aspect_ratio(@ratio),
    caption_size(@caption_size),
    caption_background(@caption_background),
    caption_opacity(@caption_opacity),
    @class
  ]}
  poster={@thumbnail}
  {@rest}
>
  <source :for={source <- @source} src={source.src} type={source.type} />

  <track
    :for={track <- @track}
    src={track.src}
    label={track.label || "English"}
    kind={track.kind || "subtitles"}
    srclang={track.srclang || "en"}
    default={track.default}
  />

  {gettext("Your browser does not support the video tag.")}
</video>

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn -> field.name end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> toggle_field()

furnishing.body:
Editorial guidelines

Every article starts as a draft. Drafts are visible to your team only, and a preview link can be shared with reviewers outside the workspace for seven days.

Headlines run to sixty characters. Anything longer is truncated in search results and in the cards used across category pages, so write the short version first.

Images need descriptive alternative text. Decorative images may leave it empty, but photographs of people, charts, and screenshots always carry a description.

Publishing is reversible. Unpublishing returns an article to draft and keeps every revision, so nothing you write here is ever lost.

helpers.code:
new_id = assigns.id || field.id

errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil)
|> assign(
  id:
    if assigns.multiple do
      new_id <> "_#{Utils.random_id()}"
    else
      new_id
    end
)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn ->
  if assigns.multiple do
    field.name <> "[]"
  else
    field.name
  end
end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> assign_new(:checked, fn -> Phoenix.HTML.Form.normalize_value("checkbox", assigns[:value]) end)
|> checkbox_field()

helpers.code:
errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

select =
  case field.value do
    val when is_integer(val) ->
      val

    val when is_float(val) ->
      val

    val when is_binary(val) and val != "" ->
      case Float.parse(val) do
        {f, ""} ->
          if f == trunc(f) do
            trunc(f)
          else
            f
          end

        _ ->
          0
      end

    _ ->
      0
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign(:name, field.name)
|> assign(:select, select)
|> assign(
  :interactive,
  if assigns.disabled do
    false
  else
    true
  end
)
|> rating()

cond do
  not is_float(select) or abs(select - trunc(select)) < 0.001 ->
    if star_position <= select do
      100
    else
      0
    end

  star_position <= floor(select) ->
    100

  star_position == ceil(select) and select - floor(select) >= 0.1 ->
    50

  true ->
    0
end

|> JS.focus_first(to: "##{id}-content")

examples:
Publish faster, without leaving the page

Compose, preview and ship every page from a single canvas. No build step, no context switching, no waiting on a deploy.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-hero-primary" variant="default" color="primary" icon="hero-rocket-launch">Start free trial <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-hero-secondary" variant="outline" color="natural">Watch the demo

Default publishing timezone

Scheduled posts are published using this timezone. Individual authors can still override it on a per-post basis.

examples.label: Hero call-to-action pair
examples.source:
Publish faster, without leaving the page

Compose, preview and ship every page from a single canvas. No build step, no context switching, no waiting on a deploy.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-hero-primary" variant="default" color="primary" icon="hero-rocket-launch">Start free trial <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-hero-secondary" variant="outline" color="natural">Watch the demo

examples.label: Settings card footer with cancel and save
examples.source:
Default publishing timezone

Scheduled posts are published using this timezone. Individual authors can still override it on a per-post basis.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-card-cancel" variant="transparent" color="natural" size="medium">Cancel <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-card-save" variant="default" color="primary" size="medium">Save changes

examples.label: Destructive confirmation with the submit button mid-flight
examples.source:
Delete this workspace

Every page, draft and media file in the workspace is removed. This cannot be undone once the job finishes.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-form-keep" variant="transparent" color="natural" size="medium">Cancel <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-form-delete" variant="default" color="danger" size="medium"> <:loading position="start"> <.component component_name="chelekom-spinner" site="Global" id="spinner-form-delete" size="extra_small" color="white" /> Deleting workspace

components.name: chelekom-input-button
components.template:
<input
  type={@type}
  id={@id}
  value={@value}
  class={[
    default_classes(@rest[:pinging], false),
    size_class(@size, @rest[:circle]),
    color_variant(@variant, @color, false),
    content_position(@content_position),
    rounded_size(@rounded),
    border_size(@border, @variant),
    @full_width && "w-full",
    @font_weight,
    @line_height,
    @display,
    @class
  ]}
  {@rest}
/>

components.name: chelekom-button-link

opts.doc: Inner block that renders HEEx content
Custom CSS class for additional styling
Determines the element position

components.template: <.link navigate={@navigate} id={@id} class={[ default_classes(@rest[:pinging], @indicator), size_class(@size, @rest[:circle]), color_variant(@variant, @color, @indicator), rounded_size(@rounded), border_size(@border, @variant), @full_width && "w-full", @font_weight, @line_height, @display, @class ]} {drop_rest(@rest)} > {render_slot(loading)} <.button_indicator position="left" size={@indicator_size} class={@indicator_class} {@rest} /> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site={assigns[:site]} :if={icon_position(@icon, @rest) == "left"} name={@icon} class={@icon_class} /> {render_slot(@inner_block) || @title} <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site={assigns[:site]} :if={icon_position(@icon, @rest) == "right"} name={@icon} class={@icon_class} /> <.button_indicator size={@indicator_size} class={@indicator_class} {@rest} /> {render_slot(loading)}

examples.label: Message box on a contact form
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="textarea-contact-message" name="message" value="" label="Message" placeholder="Tell us what you are trying to build and where you are stuck." description="The more detail you give, the fewer questions we have to send back." rows="5" space="small" rounded="medium" />

examples.label: Product review box with writing guidance
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="textarea-product-review" name="review_body" value="" label="Your review" placeholder="What did you like, and what would you change?" description="Reviews of 40 characters or more are published within one working day." rows="4" disable_resize variant="bordered" color="natural" space="small" rounded="medium" />

examples.label: Delivery note for the courier, with a floating label
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-textarea-field" site="Global" id="textarea-order-note-floating" name="courier_note" value="" label="Note for the courier" floating="outer" rows="3" disable_resize variant="bordered" color="primary" space="small" rounded="medium" />

helpers.code:
errors =
  if Phoenix.Component.used_input?(field) do
    field.errors
  else
    []
  end

assigns
|> assign(field: nil, id: assigns.id || field.id)
|> assign(:errors, Enum.map(errors, &translate_error(&1)))
|> assign_new(:name, fn -> field.name end)
|> assign_new(:value, fn -> field.value end)
|> textarea_field()
